meta.title: Retarding Potential Analyzer (RPA/RFEA)
meta.description: XHINS-RPA scans a retarding grid to obtain ion energy distribution (IEDF) and flux, covering pA–mA, with cooling/high-power options and custom flanges for thruster plume and surface process spectra.
page.title: Retarding Potential Analyzer (RPA / RFEA)
page.lead: Measures ion energy distribution and flux for surface processing, ion beam etch, and thruster plume spectrum analysis.
detail.title: Retarding Potential Analyzer (XHINS-RPA)
detail.tagline: High-resolution ion energy and flux diagnostics
detail.overview: XHINS-RPA uses a tunable retarding grid and energy-selective collector to measure IEDF and ion flux, supporting step/linear scans and low-noise front-ends. Suited for low/high flux, thruster beams, and process energy spectrum evaluation.
detail.feature1: Measures ion energy distribution (IEDF) and ion flux
detail.feature2: Tunable retarding grid with step/linear scan modes
detail.feature3: Low-noise front-end covering pA to mA ranges
detail.feature4: Cooling/high-power options; easy to pair with scanning or arrays
